_note: Combat rules + human-foe bestiary for the Encounter Generator. Parsed from the Pendragon Core Rulebook (Ch.2 & 7), Gamemaster's Handbook ('Foes'), and the Battle Cards (unit conrois with per-player scaling, morale, and ransom). See docs/encounter-generator-spec.md.

resolution.critical: roll exactly equals the value (<=20); a value over 20 is 20 (+x) with critical bonus x = value-20 added to the roll, so it criticals on any roll >= 20-x (e.g. Sword 22 criticals on 18-20) and never fails. See rules_corpus core.game-system.critical-bonus
resolution.fumble: natural 20, unless value >= 20 (then 20 is a critical and no fumble is possible)
resolution.opposed: both roll; the higher SUCCESSFUL roll wins and deals damage; equal successful rolls (or both critical) = tie and both strike; a successful-but-lower roll is a partial success and gains shield/parry protection
resolution.damage_application: winner's weapon damage minus defender Armor Points (+ shield) is applied to Hit Points; a single hit >= CON is a Major Wound; total damage >= SIZ triggers Knockdown; below Hit Points/4 = Unconscious; 0 = dead

critical_hit.melee_bonus: on a critical hit, roll the weapon's damage normally and add a flat +4D6 (worked example: 5D6 -> 5D6+4D6)
critical_hit.note: transcribe exact wording from Core Rulebook Ch.7 'Winner's Outcome' at implementation

tiers.rabble: Poorly trained and equipped; combat skills ~8-10.

weapon_note: Damage is relative to the wielder's Weapon Damage: base 'character'/'brawling' = the adversary's Weapon Damage dice, then apply damage_mod and cap at damage_max. 'fixed' uses damage_dice; 'horse' uses the mount's charge damage. A critical adds a flat +4D6 (see critical_hit).

Bear.name: Bear
Bear.notes: Maul: attacks one target/round with Claws; on a win rolls two separate 3d6 (two wounds). Ferocity: fights on 1 full round after dropping below Unconscious.
